tools.name: compare_bandwidth
tools.description: Compare fixed-bandwidth (按带宽) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of an N-Mbps public pipe from a region, tier-accumulated ($/Mbps is tiered, typically flat to 5 Mbps then steeper). charge_type 'subscription' (包月, default) or 'on_demand' (按量按小时, scaled ×730 to a month so both compare on one axi

tools.name: compare_disk_providers
tools.description: For a disk requirement (category and/or min_iops), return the single cheapest disk from EACH cloud provider, ordered cheapest-first. Best for 'which cloud has the cheapest SSD sustaining 50k IOPS'.

tools.name: compare_egress
tools.description: Compare internet egress (出网流量/按流量) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of sending volume_gb/month to the public internet from a region, tier-accumulated (egress is tiered, so a single $/GB understates it). Egress is often the hidden #1 cost — a cheap server with pricey egress can lose to a pric

tools.name: compare_eip
tools.description: Compare the monthly USD cost of a public IP (EIP/弹性公网IP) across clouds, per region. Default scope 'eip_bound' = the IP cost while ATTACHED to a running instance: AWS/GCP/Azure charge ~$3.65/mo ($0.005/h) for every public IPv4, and Volcengine/UCloud charge a smaller fee; clouds ABSENT from the result

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: For a given machine shape (vCPU/memory/GPU/charge-type), return the single cheapest instance from EACH cloud provider, ordered cheapest-first. Best for 'which cloud is cheapest for X'. Dedicated-core only unless include_burstable is set.

tools.name: compare_snapshots
tools.description: Compare snapshot (快照) storage cost across clouds: the USD $/GiB·month to store snapshot data, per region (also given as the cost of a 100 GiB snapshot/month). Snapshots are billed flat per GiB — no type/IOPS dimension like disks. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; cheapest first.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Full detail for ONE instance: all charge types (on-demand, subscription, reserved, spot) with their prices. Identify it by provider + region + instance_type (from a prior search).

tools.name: gpu_options
tools.description: Rank GPU instances by price per GPU per hour (USD). Filter by gpu_model (e.g. A100), provider, region, or charge_type. Returns the cheapest N per-GPU options.

tools.name: list_db_categories
tools.description: The database knowledge layer: cloud database CATEGORIES with when-to-use guidance and each cloud's equivalent product. Use this to pick the right kind of database for a scenario, then map it across clouds. Categories: relational (RDS), cloud-native relational (Aurora-class), cache (Redis), document

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: List the valid filter values: providers, GPU models, charge types, payment options, and the geo vocabulary (continents + countries). Call this first to know what to filter on.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Map fuzzy geography to concrete region codes. Filter by continent (NA/EU/AS/...), country, or 'near' a place (e.g. near='Singapore' returns nearby regions across all clouds, sorted by distance). Use this to turn 'near Singapore' / 'North America' into regions, then pass those to the price tools.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: What changed in cloud server pricing recently: new instance types or regions (new), delisted (removed), price increases/cuts (price_up/price_down), and sale prices against an unchanged list price (discount/discount_end). new/removed are whole instance types; a type appearing in or leaving one region

tools.name: search_databases
tools.description: Search managed-database (RDS-class) pricing across clouds, ranked by USD/hour (also monthly = ×730). For the instance-based, cross-cloud-comparable categories: relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL), later cloud-native/cache/document. Filter by engine, min/max vCPU & memory, deployment (single/multi_az), pro

tools.name: search_disks
tools.description: Search cloud block-storage (云盘/disk) pricing across 13 clouds, ranked by $/GiB·month (USD). Filter by category (hdd/standard_ssd/balanced_ssd/perf_ssd/ultra), provider, region/country/continent/near, charge_type (on_demand/subscription), and min_iops — min_iops keeps only disk types whose IOPS cap s

tools.name: search_instances
tools.description: Search the multi-cloud server catalog by CPU/memory/GPU/region/provider/charge-type and return the cheapest matches (USD/hour). Prices compare across clouds only when USD-normalized. Returns at most 50 rows plus total_matched; narrow filters if truncated. Burstable/shared-core instances (cpu_mode) a
